name: ar-company-formation
description: Form an ordinary Argentina SA, SAU, SRL or SAS in 2026. Use for entity choice, minimum capital, cash and non-cash contributions, incorporation instruments, IGJ versus provincial registration, foreign shareholders, directors' domicile and corporate CUIT. Covers national company-law conditions and current CABA registry routes, including September and November 2026 changes. Produces an incorporation checklist and tax registration handoff for professional review. It does not promise current government fees or universal completion times. Provincial procedures, regulated industries, complex contributions and future AML implementation require their own official-source review.
